text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The biting incident still overshadows<n>Shinko
Windy's every action.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's determined to change<n>people's view of her,
but her<n>impatience causes her focus to<n>waver even
more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I propose that she employ a mental<n>switch, one
where she can narrow<n>her view and only focus on
what's<n>ahead of her as she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We call the technique her "darkness<n>switch," and
with practice and<n>mastery, she'll use it to improve
her<n>focus as she strives to win the Tokai<n>Stakes.
